about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hello! I'm Tolmas. I aspire to become a Fullstack Developer. I have knowledge in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and other modern technologies. By constantly learning and practicing, I aim to create user-friendly, fast, and beautiful fullstack applications.
about.p2: I love not only writing code but also working on every detail and bringing the quality of the product to the highest level. I am learning REST API, GraphQL, Socket.io, JWT, OAuth 2.0, Docker and DevOps technologies. I would be glad to participate in your team or project.
